newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-DETTORI MAY BE SEARCHING FOR RIDE IN ARC.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-DETTORI MAY BE SEARCHING FOR RIDE IN ARC.

text.p: Frankie Dettori, who won all seven races at Ascot on Saturday, may be left searching for a ride in Sunday's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, the traditional autumn showpiece of European horse racing.
His intended mount, the Ascot Gold Cup winner Classic Cliche, missed a gallop a couple of days ago after looking dull in his coat, prompting speculation the colt would miss the Arc.
But Classic Cliche has since cantered and Godolphin racing manager Simon Crisford stressed no decision had yet been made. "As soon as a decision is made we will make an announcement," he added.
Bookmakers have re-instated Classic Cliche in the betting but if the horse is withdrawn and Dettori switches horses there could be a shake-up.
Ladbrokes spokesman Ian Wassell said: "Whatever Frankie rides will be very well backed, that's a certainty."
